description: Fix P2M4_Repeat desc-key reference — CIG bug STARC-176797: contract points at P2M1_Repeat's desc loc-key instead of its own (observed in 4.7). Without this patch, P2M4_Repeat players see P2M1's Energy-Anomaly flavor text and our enhancement injects ASD2A blueprints; with this patch, P2M4_Repeat resolves to its own Power-Usage desc and picks up the correct ASD2D pool.

locstring_workarounds.description: The XML edit above only corrects our local generator's view — the game still reads the bugged Description pointer from Data.p4k at runtime, so an in-game P2M4_Repeat contract still looks up P2M1_Repeat_desc. Append P2M4_Repeat_desc's enhanced content (its flavor text + its own blueprint pool) onto P2M1_Repeat_desc so the mis-routed lookup produces the right text. P2M1_Repeat players see the extra P2M4 block as a labeled appendix; once CIG fixes STARC-176797 this block can be removed.
